verdict.rationale: Airbyte has a documented API (with access tokens) for programmatic control and a documented MCP server integration for connecting agents like Claude/Cursor to Airbyte data, and the Connection Timeline shows historical sync events; these together suggest a status/diagnose/retrigger workflow is technically possible. However, no evidence explicitly shows the MCP server or API exposing 'diagnose failed run' or 're-trigger sync' as first-class agent-facing operations, and the connection timeline/notifications are UI-oriented, not confirmed as MCP-exposed tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCP tools/API endpoints for checking sync status, diagnosing failure causes, and re-triggering a failed sync, plus independent/hands-on confirmation this works end-to-end via an agent.
